diff --git a/config/commands/edit_packaging.sh b/config/commands/edit_packaging.sh
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..f17916b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/config/commands/edit_packaging.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+# @yaml
+# signature: edit_packaging <target_file> <patch>
+# docstring: Apply a unified diff patch to a packaging file (e.g., pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, MANIFEST.in).
+# arguments:
+#   target_file:
+#     type: string
+#     description: Path to the packaging file to edit
+#     required: true
+#   patch:
+#     type: string
+#     description: Unified diff to apply
+#     required: true
+edit_packaging() {
+    if [ -z "$1" ] || [ -z "$2" ]; then
+        echo "Usage: edit_packaging <target_file> <patch>"
+        return 1
+    fi
+    local target_file="$1"
+    local patch="$2"
+
+    # Reuse the common apply_patch helper (same as other command scripts)
+    apply_patch "$target_file" "$patch"
+    local status=$?
+    if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then
+        echo "Packaging file $target_file updated successfully."
+    else
+        echo "Failed to apply patch to $target_file."
+    fi
+    return $status
+}
diff --git a/config/commands/verify_packaging.sh b/config/commands/verify_packaging.sh
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..ac2887e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/config/commands/verify_packaging.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# @yaml
+# signature: verify_packaging
+# docstring: Verify that all top‑level packages (directories with __init__.py) are present in the built wheel.
+verify_packaging() {
+    # Build the wheel (if not already built)
+    python -m build --wheel . >/dev/null 2>&1
+    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
+        echo "Wheel build failed."
+        return 1
+    fi
+
+    # Find the generated .whl file
+    wheel_file=$(ls dist/*.whl | head -n1)
+    if [ -z "$wheel_file" ]; then
+        echo "No wheel file found in dist/."
+        return 1
+    fi
+
+    # List contents of the wheel
+    wheel_contents=$(zipinfo -1 "$wheel_file")
+
+    # Find expected top‑level packages (directories containing __init__.py)
+    missing_packages=()
+    while IFS= read -r -d '' pkg_dir; do
+        pkg_name=$(basename "$pkg_dir")
+        if ! echo "$wheel_contents" | grep -q "^$pkg_name/"; then
+            missing_packages+=("$pkg_name")
+        fi
+    done < <(find . -type f -name "__init__.py" -printf '%h\0')
+
+    if [ ${#missing_packages[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
+        # Emit JSON payload for the harness
+        for pkg in "${missing_packages[@]}"; do
+            echo "{\"error\":\"missing_package\",\"package\":\"$pkg\"}"
+        done
+        return 1
+    fi
+
+    # All expected packages are present
+    return 0
+}
